text: The operator adjusted the parameter in the configuration file and reloaded it remotely.

text: The product should work well with other software.

text: The hospital must maintain adequate staffing levels.

text: The user should find the app easy to navigate.

text: The contractor must meet reasonable performance benchmarks.

text: The API documentation must be thorough.

text: The analysis produced fairly consistent results.

text: The facility must maintain appropriate sanitation levels.

explanation: 'Appropriate' sanitation has no defined standard cited.

text: The dashboard should load fast on all devices.

text: The package should arrive within a few business days.

text: The estimate for the task should be realistic.

text: He noticed the technician servicing the equipment in the storage area.
label: attachment
explanation: 'In the storage area' can attach to 'servicing' (where the work happened) or to 'noticed' (where he noticed).

text: The analyst submitted the data with the correction notes.
label: attachment
explanation: 'With the correction notes' can attach to 'submitted' (attached to the submission) or to 'data' (embedded in it).

text: The detective found the suspect with the knife.
label: attachment
explanation: 'With the knife' can attach to 'found' (the detective used it) or to 'suspect' (the suspect had it).

text: She reviewed the clause with the penalty conditions.
label: attachment
explanation: 'With the penalty conditions' can attach to 'reviewed' (focusing on them) or to 'clause' (which contained them).

text: The director approved the plan for the renovation with the reduced budget.
label: attachment
explanation: 'With the reduced budget' can attach to 'approved' (she approved given the budget) or to 'plan' (the plan included the budget).

text: She interviewed the senior managers and analysts about the project.
label: attachment
explanation: 'Senior' can modify only 'managers' or both 'managers and analysts'.

text: They only submitted the first module for review.
label: attachment
explanation: 'Only' can scope over 'the first module' (no other module was submitted) or over 'submitted' (they did nothing else with it).

text: He attached the file to the email with the sensitive data.
label: attachment
explanation: 'With the sensitive data' can attach to 'file' (it contained sensitive data) or to 'email' (the email contained it).

text: He noticed the error in the script written by the contractor.
label: attachment
explanation: 'Written by the contractor' can modify 'script' (the contractor wrote it) or 'error' (unusual — the contractor made the error).

text: She accepted the offer with the extended deadline.
label: attachment
explanation: 'With the extended deadline' can attach to 'accepted' (under that condition) or to 'offer' (which included it).

text: She submitted the draft to the editor that required significant revisions.
label: attachment
explanation: 'That required significant revisions' can modify 'draft' (the draft needed revisions) or 'editor' (the editor who requires revisions from authors) — both readings are natural.

text: She nearly missed every scheduled review.
label: attachment
explanation: 'Nearly' can modify 'missed' (she almost missed each one) or 'every' (she missed almost all but not every one).

text: She delivered the presentation with the new sales strategy.
label: attachment
explanation: 'With the new sales strategy' can attach to 'delivered' (she incorporated it) or to 'presentation' (it contained the strategy).

text: He distributed the updated report to the engineers and testers in the room.
label: attachment
explanation: 'In the room' can attach to 'testers' only or to both 'engineers and testers'.

text: She photographed the tourists visiting the old city walls.
label: attachment
explanation: 'Visiting the old city walls' can modify 'tourists' (they were visiting) or describe where the photographing occurred.

text: A few modules were not fully tested in the regression cycle.
label: scope
explanation: Can mean some modules lacked full testing or no modules in the small set were fully tested.

text: All participants must register online or in person before the deadline.
label: scope
explanation: Each may choose either method, OR all must use one designated method — the scope is ambiguous.

text: Not every feature must be completed before the deadline.
label: scope
explanation: Can mean some features may be skipped or that no features need the deadline met.

text: All employees must submit a report or attend the debrief session.
label: scope
explanation: Each employee may do either (distributive) OR all must do one designated option (collective).

text: The alert is sent to the on-call engineer or to the backup contact.
label: scope
explanation: One receives the alert (exclusive OR) OR both may receive it (inclusive OR).

text: All test cases did not pass on the initial automated run.
label: scope
explanation: Can mean no test cases passed or not all test cases passed.

text: Each component passed the functional test and the performance benchmark.
label: scope
explanation: Did each component pass both tests individually or did the set of components collectively pass both?

text: Managers should report the incident to the HR team or to the legal department.
label: scope
explanation: Either team is sufficient (inclusive OR) OR exactly one must be notified (exclusive OR).

text: Staff can request remote work on Mondays or on Fridays each week.
label: scope
explanation: Each staff member may choose either day (individual) OR all staff may only use one designated remote day.

text: Every student must complete the exam or the practical assignment.
label: scope
explanation: Each student must complete at least one (individual choice) OR the entire class must complete one option collectively.

text: Employees should not share credentials or access rights with colleagues.
label: scope
explanation: Should not share either (both prohibited) OR should not share at least one of them.

text: All students completed the quiz and the group assignment.
label: scope
explanation: Each student completed both (distributive) vs. all students collectively completed one or both (collective).

text: The policy does not apply to managers or senior directors.
label: scope
explanation: Can mean the policy applies to neither or does not apply to at least one group.

text: Not all patches submitted in the last sprint were successfully reviewed.
label: scope
explanation: Can mean some patches were not reviewed or no patches were reviewed at all.

text: Some features were excluded from the current release.
label: scope
explanation: Can mean a subset was excluded OR the sentence implies all features labeled 'some' were excluded.
